_comment: C5 — stores that feed operator surfaces, declared so something compares their
declared cadence against their observed output age.
Rows use the SAME schema as config/lane_registry.json and are evaluated by the
SAME code (scripts/lib/lane_registry.evaluate_lane). This is deliberately an
extension of the existing liveness monitor, not a second mechanism: AGENTS.md
§13.5 exists because a parallel monitor is how two answers to one question get
built. It lives in its own file only because config/lane_registry.json is owned
by another agent in this run.
Why this exists: strategy_signals stopped advancing on 2026-08-07 and nothing
watched the date. Three detectors reported nothing for 24 days. A store whose
last write date goes stale while an operator surface reads it is the finding
Verdicts come from the shared evaluator: LIVE, SLOW, SILENT, EXPECTED_SILENT,
UNVERIFIABLE, ORPHANED. SILENT and ORPHANED are findings.
Every column below was verified against information_schema, not guessed.

lanes.surface: Strategy Desk / momentum + scalp Telegram alerts
lanes.note: The 24-day outage. Written in-process by trade_ai_orchestrator via sync_strategy_signals; it has no cron line of its own, which is why a scheduler search alone reported it unscheduled.

lanes.surface: trade page candidates; upstream of every strategy signal
lanes.note: Kept producing through the outage, which is how the break was localised downstream of discovery.
Grok dates a momentum_scalp proposal cliff to 2026-06-30, earlier than the signal break and still unowned. This row makes that visible instead of inferred.
Still receives rows; its last GO was 2026-08-13 per Grok. Row age alone will read LIVE — a store can be written and still be useless, which is why this is a cadence monitor and not a quality one.
An earlier census claimed this table was dead; Grok measured 7,346 rows in 30h. Declared here so the claim is checkable rather than remembered.

SCOPED DELIBERATELY. The unscoped row above reads LIVE because other strategies keep writing the table, while momentum_scalp proposals stopped 2026-06-30 (Grok). A whole-table cadence check cannot see a per-strategy cliff -- the aggregate hides it. This is the same shape as an audit that reads OK because zero input makes its condition false.
